notes: Page 1 is the whole front sheet. It shows the minifigure (hat, torso, legs, not in the parts list, so not recorded), the radar post sub-assembly, chassis step 1, the front-end sub-assembly (steps 1-3 in the yellow box) and main steps 2-4.
Chassis step 1: the two black 6157 wheel-holder plates go on the studs at each end of the 52036 base (b2, b3).

Front-end box: the white 52038 (b4) takes two trans-red cheese slopes (b5, b6) and a white groove tile (b7). The POLICE sticker (52814) goes on b7. A dark grey piece appears under it in box step 3 but I could not identify it, so it is not recorded.

Main step 2 attaches b4 to the front of the base. Steps 3-4 add the wheel arches and the steering stand. A black 1x2 brick (b13) goes into the recess. Which arches go in step 3 and which in step 4 is my best reading, and so are the exact studs they sit on.

Radar post: the antenna (b15) stands in the round plate (b14). The black clip plate (b16) and the bar (b17) clip onto the antenna rod. The printed tile (b19) sits on b16. The loudhailer (b18) clips onto b17. Which black part is which is my best guess from the small drawings.

Pieces in the parts list not yet placed: 2412b, 2431, 2437, 298c02, 3020, 3023, 3068b, 3710, 3962b, 43337, 45677, 51739, 52501, the other 54200 slopes, wheels and tyres. They are probably on later pages.

The rear (red tail-light) end of the car is b4 with arches b9 and b10. The front end with yellow lights is b21 with arches b11 and b12. This follows page 1 step 3, where I put the first pair of arches next to b4.

Page 2 step 5 attaches the front-end sub-assembly: 52038 (b21), two trans-yellow slopes (b22, b23), a grille tile (b24) and a dark 1x4 tile (b25). The matching dark tile for the rear end (b20) was missing from page 1, so it is added here on b4.

The side panels 43337 (b26, b27), the second black brick (b28), the two 2x4 plates, the 45677 and the wedge plate were already in place in the step 5 and 6 drawings. They are not drawn clearly, so exactly where they sit is my best reading.

Step 7: the two windscreens (b34, b35) are joined by a 1x4 plate (b36) across their top studs. Step 8: two inverted slopes (b37, b38), a roof plate (b39) and two lever antenna bases (b40, b41). Step 9 box: a 1x4 plate (b42), a 1x2 plate (b43), two trans-dark-blue slopes (b44, b45) and a grille tile (b46) make the roof light.

Step 10: the four wheels sit on the two pins of each 6157 holder, two wheels per holder. The radio (b55) is held by the minifigure, which is not recorded, so it has no join. The sticker sheet 52814 is not recorded as a piece. Stickers go on the hood tile, roof and sides.

The system listed the two trans-red slopes as unplaced. I already placed both as b5 and b6 on page 1, so I did not add them again. The two trans-dark-blue slopes were not in the unplaced list, but they are in the parts list and are used in the roof light, so I added them as b44 and b45.
I added no new pieces or joins. The three groups are real and the booklet builds them separately.

Group 1 is the police car: b1 to b13, b20 to b54. Group 2 is the radar post (b14 to b19): the round plate, antenna, clip parts, loudhailer and printed tile. The booklet builds it on its own, and step 10 shows it standing beside the car.

Group 3 is the radio b55. It is held in the minifigure's hand in step 10. The minifigure's own parts are not in the parts list, so I did not record them as pieces. That leaves the radio with no part to join to. I did not invent a join, because the booklet never attaches it to the car or the radar post.
No change. The three groups are real, so I added no pieces or joins.

The police car (b1 to b13, b20 to b54) is one model. The radar post (b14 to b19) is a second model. The booklet builds it on its own and step 10 shows it standing next to the car. Neither is attached to the other.

The radio (b55) is a minifigure accessory. In the booklet it is only held in the minifigure's hand. The minifigure's own parts are not in the parts list and I did not record them as pieces. The booklet shows no clip or stud connection from the radio to any recorded piece, and I would be inventing a join if I added one.
If the minifigure were recorded as a part, the radio would join its hand. The graph would then still have the car and the radar post as two models.
